target.DIAGNOSIS_CORRECTED_2026-08-27: NOT a Target tarpit -- that earlier label was WRONG. Root cause is Chrome FREEZING/DISCARDING backgrounded tabs. PROOF: (a) a long-hidden tab runs synchronous JS instantly (document.title, performance.now() advance) but NO fetch ever settles -- not redsky, not same-origin target.com '/', not even cross-origin example.com no-cors. Promise .then/.finally are microtasks (not timer-throttled), so if any fetch had settled, done would flip -- none did => the tab's task queues are FROZEN. (b) document.hidden===true / visibilityState==='hidden' on both the old tab and a freshly created one => the whole MCP tab-group window is backgrounded. (c) A FRESH tab (not yet frozen) DID work: redsky plp_search_v2 returned HTTP 200 with 24 products in 325ms -- so the engine path and RedSky params are 100% sound. (d) But under memory pressure Chrome DISCARDED that fresh tab within ~20-30s, and then the entire tab group vanished ('No tab group exists'), so a 75-page (~75s) sweep can't survive. UNBLOCK: the sweep needs the Chrome window VISIBLE/FOREGROUND (not backgrounded/minimized) so tabs aren't frozen or discarded. Cannot force foreground from these tools (user on Remote Control). RETRY PLAN: tabs_context_mcp{createIfEmpty:true} -> new tab -> navigate target.com -> check document.hidden; if hidden===false, run the detached sweep (pace 800ms, abort 8s, break 3 errs) and extract fast; if hidden===true, the window is still backgrounded -> do NOT hammer, extend cool-down and tell the user to foreground Chrome. Hits use SHORT keys + image_name only (no URLs) so results read back without redaction; reconstruct productUrl=target.com/p/-/A-{tcin} and imageUrl=target.scene7.com/is/image/Target/{img} in post.
